newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: SOCCER-ECUADOR'S WORLD CUP CHANCES SUFFER SEVERE BLOW.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ECUADOR'S WORLD CUP CHANCES SUFFER SEVERE BLOW.

text.p: Ecuador's chances of a first World Cup finals appearance were dealt a severe blow Sunday when they were held to a 1-1 draw by lightweights Venezuela.
Ecuador had been counting on maximum points in their South American qualifier against a team who had only collected two points from their previous 11 qualifying matches.
But after taking a 55th-minute lead through Ivan Hurtado, Ecuador saw victory slip from the grasp when substitute Gabriel Miranda equalised eight minutes from the end.

The result, in a match between the only South American countries never to have played at the World Cup finals, left Ecuador fifth in the single South American World Cup qualifying group with 15 points from 12 games.
They are one point behind fourth-placed Chile, who have played a game less.
"We expected more. We expected to win. The situation has become more complicated with this result and with the points we lost before," said Ecuador's Colombian coach Francisco Maturana.
"But while there's a chance, we must keep on fighting."
